verdict.rationale: Base44 documents its own programmatic interfaces: an SDK for CRUD on app entities and for using Base44 as a backend service, a CLI that can run commands against any app on the account, and an MCP server that exposes the account to AI assistants. However, no published REST/OpenAPI spec was found, as all candidate OpenAPI paths returned 404, so 'public API' is met only through SDK, CLI and MCP surfaces. missing for 10: a documented public REST/HTTP API reference or OpenAPI spec, documented coverage of account and app-building operations beyond entity data, independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use the SDK to build your own frontend or backend that uses Base44 as a backend service.
entities: Work with your app's data entities using CRUD operations.
Create new backend projects, sync data models and code, deploy resources, and run commands against any app on your account
The Base44 MCP server exposes your Base44 account to any MCP-compatible AI assistant.
